summary: The Cop spins out of the bathroom seeking cover while Neo's bullets splinter the door jamb around him. Just as he is about to whirl back into the room, he freezes, seized by something unseen. His body begins to spasm and his M-16 drops to the floor, its mounted flashlight casting long shadows that spring upward.

what_changes.before: Actively moving to take cover, spinning out of the bathroom away from Neo's fire.
what_changes.after: Frozen and helpless, his body seized and spasming as his weapon falls.
what_changes.evidence: About to whirl back in, he freezes as something seems to seize hold of him.  The Cop's body starts to spasm and his M-16 falls to the ground

what_changes.before: Still armed and in control of his M-16.
what_changes.after: Disarmed and physically overtaken by an unseen force.
what_changes.evidence: something seems to seize hold of him.  The Cop's body starts to spasm and his M-16 falls to the ground, long shadows springing up from the mounted flashlight.

event_hint.one_line: The Cop, taking cover from Neo's gunfire in Room 608, is suddenly seized and disarmed by an unseen force.
